title: Pella / v26 thin layered armour
credit: Geometry: Martin Taichl (@Martin), CC BY 4.0. Measured coating reference: Jakub.Vildomec MCRN Tachi / Rocinante fan model, CC BY 4.0. Adapted for this project.
note: Thin overlapping outer skins on four engine pods and two forward armour fields, with the original emblems raised onto the coating. Smooth dark finish, recessed flat backing, hatches, lamps and four drives retained. Reference-guided panel interpretation; hidden construction is not production-certified. Nine additional localized practical lights at existing pod-edge and bow-service fixtures, plus a tiny red marker on the second existing antenna. The original 25 lights, four blue drives, hull, layered armour, maps and emblems remain unchanged. Exact fixture brightness is a show-reference interpretation, not a production lighting blueprint.
beforeNote: Recessed flat-faced internal backing replaces the protruding rounded filler. The smooth dark outer armour, hatches, two forward emblems, ship lights and four engines are unchanged. Reference-guided fan reconstruction; stealth panel layering remains a separate finishing pass.

title: Anubis / production-reference finish
note: Owner-accepted hull, fittings and lighting. Localized red collar emission follows existing cheek caps beneath the raised spine; individual production lenses merge in the glow, so source cap geometry is retained. Blue-cyan glow follows the complete existing inner bow lining, with uneven bright patches, perimeter spill and concealed fills illuminating the real background and port surround. Shared emission-only glow preserves source colours and maps. The owner noted that the result is a bit bright and accepted it as shown; brightness is preserved. Cyan segmented drive and compact blue-white exhaust preserved. The source creator describes this fan kit as bulkier than the production ship; no hull redesign, mirroring or smoothing was applied.
credit: Geometry: Martin Taichl / Martin / taichl, CC BY 4.0. Source geometry retained; X890 registered fittings, procedural charcoal finish, existing emissive cap materials and separate drive effect. Unofficial fan recreation.
